simulation_error.mechanism: gate record fails; the release manifest lists WAVEFORM as a blocker

feature_recomputation.mechanism: archive and stored row disagree; determinism claim fails

spike_count_agreement.mechanism: archive and stored row describe different simulations

voltage_range.mechanism: qc_flags raises nonphysical_voltage on the same band (PHYSICAL_V_MIN_MV/PHYSICAL_V_MAX_MV) -> excluded corpus-wide

discontinuity.mechanism: a step larger than one dt of the integrator can produce; co-occurs with nonfinite/nonphysical voltage in every observed case and is reported if it ever does not

depolarisation_block.mechanism: two detectors disagree about one trace; recorded as a finding to adjudicate, never used to drop a row

spike_shape.mechanism: a 10 mV / 10 ms screening bound, not a validity criterion; a broad-prior draw may legitimately have a wide, small AP

baseline_stability.mechanism: the strict-QC sensitivity arm drops rows flagged unstable_baseline; the primary arm keeps them and says so

disposition.note: counts are FINDINGS, not samples: one sample can raise several and they must not be summed to a sample count. Each record lists at most ten; n_findings_total is the true sum.

features_recomputed_from: the reloaded .npz archive, not the in-memory simulation
not_checked_here: half-step agreement: a per-model property already measured by the convergence audits (gate N3) and the perturbation repeatability battery, not re-derived from a trace sample
